text: {"sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' THEN '2026-07' WHEN o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' THEN '2026-08' END AS month, SUM(oi.amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND (o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' OR o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31') GROUP BY month ORDER BY sales_amount DESC","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
